Analysis

Theme

The Council went from recommending to ordering

"Decides" appears in 20% of resolutions in the founding era and 96% since 2022. "Acting under Chapter VII" went from about 1% of resolutions before 1988 to 50%.

Before the 1990s most resolutions "call upon" or "request". The Council's binding power under Article 25 of the Charter was there, but rarely used. The first resolution to state "Acting under Chapter VII" is 253 (1968), on Southern Rhodesia. The phrase then stays rare until Iraq's invasion of Kuwait: from 1990 it becomes standard wording.

Rules for every state

Since 2001 some resolutions bind all UN members in general terms rather than about one crisis, which lawyers call the Council's quasi-legislative role. Three landmarks:

  • 1373 (2001): duties on all states to counter terrorist financing and safe havens.
  • 1540 (2004): all states must stop non-state actors getting weapons of mass destruction.
  • 2178 (2014): obligations on all states over foreign terrorist fighters.
